Metadata.title: Overdrive: a game library for the PS5
Metadata.description: Overdrive is PS5 homebrew that runs on the console itself: a game library you browse with the controller, with the focus, art and pace of the system store. See the PS4 and PS5 catalog and how to install it.
Metadata.ogAlt: Overdrive's home screen on a TV in a dark room, beside the line "A game library, browsed the way your PS5 does."

Hero.title: A game library, browsed the way your PS5 does.
Hero.lede: Overdrive is homebrew that runs on the console itself. Move through the library with the controller, with the focus, art and pace of the system store.
Hero.shotAlt: Overdrive's home screen on the TV: Days Gone in the spotlight, five featured games beside it, Popular now below.

Tour.label: Tour
Tour.homeBody: Five picks take turns every seven seconds, as they do on the console. Point at one to hold it there.
Tour.gridTitle: Six to a row, as fast as you hold the stick.
Tour.gridBody: Covers load ahead of the focus and stay on the console once fetched, so going back through the library is instant.
Tour.gridAlt: The library grid on the console: a card in focus, its PS5 tag on the cover.
Tour.filtersTitle: Every filter says what it will find.
Tour.filtersBody: Platform, genre, features, release, size. Each option shows how many games it leaves, and the ones that would leave none step out of the way.
Tour.filtersAlt: The filters panel: PS5 and PS4 tiles with their counts, genre pills, RPG picked, Puzzle and Fighting dimmed at zero.
Tour.pageBody: Art, details and screenshots, each one full screen with a press.
Tour.pageAlt: Cyberpunk 2077's page on the TV: a screenshot open in the gallery, its thumbnails below and the details beside it.

Install.title: Install it in three steps.
Install.lede: Overdrive is a PS5 app like any other once it is on the console: no PC in the room after this.
Install.step1Detail: A PS5 running a homebrew loader, with an ELF loader listening for payloads.
Install.step2Title: Copy the app to the console
Install.step3Detail: Overdrive then sits on the home screen like any game.
